deleteAfterRead.title: Auto-delete Objects
deleteAfterRead.description: Specifies to delete objects after consuming them.

autoCreateBucket.title: Autocreate Bucket
autoCreateBucket.description: Specifies to automatically create the bucket.

includeBody.title: Include Body
includeBody.description: If true, the exchange is consumed and put into the body and closed. If false, the Object stream is put raw into the body and the headers are set with the object metadata.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The bucket prefix to consider while searching.

ignoreBody.title: Ignore Body
ignoreBody.description: If true, the Object body is ignored. Setting this to true overrides any behavior defined by the `includeBody` option. If false, the object is put in the body.

cephUrl.title: Ceph Url Address
cephUrl.description: Set the Ceph Object Storage Address Url.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The number of milliseconds before the next poll of the selected bucket.
